body_lead: Patna: The Bihar Sugarcane Industries Department has launched a digital initiative to provide sugarcane farmers direct access to departmental schemes, services and application-related information, Bhaskar reported. Sugarcane Industries Minister Sanjay Kumar on Wednesday launched the ‘Ganna Saathi’ AI chatbot and ‘Ganna Kisan Pehchan Patra’ (Sugarcane Farmer Identity Card). The identity card will serve as a unique digital identity for each sugarcane farmer.
